critical_findings.tfidf_174k_formal_suite_complete: All 8 TF-IDF representations evaluated at 174k scale with frozen harness v3 (exact k-NN on valid subset for adversarial benchmarks). All 8 PASS both adversarial gates. Best: cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (LangDom=0.4895, JuristPref=0.7265). Production default validated. Full-corpus benchmarks: temporal_stability PASS (0.78 for full_text_tfidf_light), hierarchy_coherence FAIL (nesting~0.65), cluster_coherence FAIL (branch_purity~0.3-0.35, lang_purity~0.6), boilerplate_resistance FAIL (resistance≈-0.84).
critical_findings.citation_heritage_174k_validated: Run on 1,020 positive + 1,020 negative citation pairs from resolved citation graph (2,019/2,105 citations resolved). Citation-based signals dominate: 4/8 PASS AUC-ROC ≥ 0.7 including production default. Best: cited_decisions_tfidf (AUC=0.7426), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.7 (AUC=0.7290), cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (AUC=0.7163). Text-based signals FAIL (regeste_tfidf AUC=0.503 ~random). Confirms fundamental two-mode tradeoff: citation signals recover citation heritage, text signals do not.
critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_generalization_: v17b (1000 decisions, 6 reps): 15-25% hierarchy purity gain REPRODUCED across 4 seeds (ratios 1.15-1.24). At 174k scale (8 reps, 15k subsample): label normalization still improves hierarchy purity (ratios 4-10x) but regime is fundamentally different - 213 raw labels → 111 normalized vs 104→54 at 1000; NMI decreases on normalized labels at 174k (e.g., cited_decisions_tfidf: 0.158→0.150 hierarchy NMI). Conclusion: v17b label normalization is REPRODUCED as a method but does not 'generalize' in the sense of same-magnitude effect; 174k fine-grained labels operate in a different regime requiring separate validation.
critical_findings.v18_coarse_hierarchy_negative: Even at coarse 4-label branch level (oeffentliches_recht, zivilrecht, strafrecht, sozialversicherungsrecht), best purity 0.65 (linear_citation_concat) < 0.7 threshold. All 6 representations FAIL branch-level hierarchy coherence. Fundamental limitation: TF-IDF and citation-based representations lack sufficient signal density for branch-level legal structure recovery at any scale.
critical_findings.dense_embeddings_blocked: Legal-distance 174k dense embeddings only 3/26 years ACCEPTED (2000-2002, ~19k decisions). 15/26 years checkpointed (2000-2014, ~100k decisions) PENDING AUDIT. Years 2019, 2025, 2026 not processed. Center_projected baselines FAIL jurist gate at 174k (JP=0.39-0.42). Metric learning/hybrids/citation roles at 174k PENDING dense delivery.
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_confirmed: TF-IDF at 174k: Citation-based signals (cited_decisions_tfidf family) PASS citation_heritage (AUC>0.71) and adversarial gates; Text-based signals (regeste_tfidf, full_text_tfidf_light) FAIL citation_heritage (AUC~0.5-0.63) but PASS branch metadata recovery. Same tradeoff seen in dense embeddings at 165k: center_projected FAILS jurist gate (0.39) but has good multilingual transfer; cited_decisions_tfidf hybrids PASS jurist gate but poor cross-language retrieval.
critical_findings.jurist_study_framework_ready: Simulation framework complete for pairwise preference, cluster coherence, zoom task, cross-language retrieval. Requires 5-10 Swiss jurists for human validation. No budget allocated.
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative: All 174k representations show negative resistance_score (~ -0.84), confirming this proxy measures language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate. Consistent across TF-IDF and dense embeddings.
critical_findings.production_default_validated: cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 is PRODUCTION DEFAULT: PASS both adversarial gates (LangDom=0.4895, JuristPref=0.7265), PASS citation_heritage (AUC=0.716), operational at full 173,963 decisions with 5 zoom levels. Wired in product lane as PRODUCT_SERVING_DEFAULT.
critical_findings.linear_hybrid05_concat_scale_dependency: 15-year (91,929): FAILS jurist gate (LangDom=0.8086 PASS, JP=0.4730 FAIL, delta=-0.2465 vs baseline). 19-year (122,015): PASSES both gates (LangDom=0.7784, JP=0.5395) but still below TF-IDF baseline (0.7235). Clear scale dependency confirmed; two-mode tradeoff persists — citation signals dominate jurist preference.
critical_findings.section_crosslingual_sachverhalt_superio: Sachverhalt (facts) superior cross-lingual alignment vs Erwaegungen (reasoning). Sachverhalt cp_64: cross_lang_same_branch=0.282, invariance_gap=0.187. Erwaegungen cp_64: cross_lang_same_branch=0.094, invariance_gap=0.452. Center projection improves both (sachverhalt gap 0.304→0.187, erwaegungen 0.538→0.452). Completed at 1K sample; full density blocked pending dense embeddings.
